name: Agent
description: Spawns a subagent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. The subagent runs independently with its own conversation context.

description.description: A brief description of what the subagent will do.

model.description: Optional model override for the subagent.

name.description: Optional teammate name for lifecycle tracking.

poll_ms.description: Polling interval in milliseconds for wait/resume.

prompt.description: The task description for the subagent.

task_id.description: Optional existing task id to poll/resume.

wait.description: If true, waits for completion before returning.

name: AskUserQuestion
description: Asks structured multiple-choice questions and returns a machine-readable answer payload.

answers.description: Optional user answers keyed by question id.

questions.description: Questions to present to the user.

name: Bash
description: Executes a shell command and returns its output. Use this for running programs, scripts, git commands, and system operations.

description.description: A brief description of what the command does.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 120000 (2 minutes).

name: Edit
description: Performs exact string replacements in files. The old_string must be unique in the file unless replace_all is true.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to edit.

old_string.description: The exact string to find and replace.

replace_all.description: If true, replace all occurrences. Default is false.

name: Glob
description: Finds files matching a glob pattern. Supports ** for recursive matching. Returns paths sorted by modification time (most recent first).

path.description: The directory to search in. Defaults to the working directory.

name: Grep
description: Searches file contents using regular expressions. Uses ripgrep (rg) if available, otherwise falls back to Go's regexp.

context.description: Number of context lines to show before and after each match. Only used with output_mode "content".

include.description: File pattern to include in the search (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}"). Alias of glob.

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines, "files_with_matches" shows file paths, "count" shows match counts.

path.description: File or directory to search in. Defaults to the working directory.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for.

name: NotebookEdit
description: Edits a cell in a Jupyter notebook (.ipynb file). Modifies the source of the specified cell.

action.description: Cell operation: update (default), add, or delete.

cell_index.description: The 0-based index of the target cell.

cell_type.description: Cell type for add action: code (default) or markdown.

new_source.description: The new source content for update/add actions.

name: Read
description: Reads a file from the local filesystem, returning contents with line numbers.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to read.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read. Defaults to 2000.

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-based). Defaults to 1.

name: Sleep
description: Sleeps for a requested duration in milliseconds.

duration_ms.description: Requested sleep duration in milliseconds; bounded to 1..600000.

name: TodoWrite
description: Manages a task checklist. Create, update, and track todos for the current session.

todos.description: Array of todo items with content, status, and optional activeForm fields.

name: WebFetch
description: Fetches content from a URL via HTTP GET. HTML tags are stripped for cleaner output.

format.description: Output format: markdown (default), text, or html.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds. Defaults to 30, max 120.

name: WebSearch
description: Performs a web search and returns ranked results from a configured provider.

num_results.description: Number of results to return. Default is 10.

name: Write
description: Writes content to a file, creating it and any parent directories if they do not exist. Overwrites existing files.

content.description: The content to write to the file.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to write.

name: brief
description: Delivers user-facing messages with optional attachment metadata.

message.description: Message to deliver to the user.

name: config
description: Gets and sets deterministic local configuration values for this workspace.

name: cron_create
description: Schedules a local cron-like reminder with deterministic validation.

cron.description: Five-field cron expression (M H DoM Mon DoW).

prompt.description: Prompt payload to run when matched.

recurring.description: Whether the job should recur. Defaults to true.

name: cron_delete
description: Deletes a scheduled local cron job by id.

name: cron_list
description: Lists scheduled local cron jobs.

name: enter_plan_mode
description: Enters plan mode so the model can explore and design before implementation.

name: exit_plan_mode
description: Exits plan mode and confirms implementation can begin.

allowedPrompts.description: Optional prompt-based permissions requested by the plan.

name: ls
description: Lists files and directories in a path. Returns one entry per line, with trailing / for directories.

path.description: Directory to list. Defaults to the working directory.

name: lsp
description: Provider-agnostic code intelligence fallback (definitions, references, symbols, hover).

operation.description: goToDefinition, findReferences, hover, documentSymbol, workspaceSymbol, goToImplementation, prepareCallHierarchy, incomingCalls, outgoingCalls

name: memory
description: Persists simple key-value notes scoped to the current workspace.

action.description: Operation to perform: set, get, delete, or list.

value.description: Value to store for set action.

name: powershell
description: Executes a local shell command with PowerShell-compatible naming and Bash safety guardrails.

description.description: A brief description of what the command does.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 120000 (2 minutes).

name: remote_trigger
description: Manages provider-agnostic remote triggers using deterministic local state.

action.description: list, get, create, update, or run

name: repl
description: Relays tool input to a local primitive tool and returns the wrapped result.

input.description: JSON input forwarded to the target tool.

name: send_message
description: Sends team messages to one teammate or broadcasts to all teammates.

from.description: Optional sender name. Defaults to team_lead.

to.description: Recipient teammate name or * for broadcast.

name: skill
description: Runs local skills and exposes a deterministic skill catalog.

args.description: Optional arguments passed to the skill.

name: synthetic_output
description: Returns structured JSON output in a deterministic passthrough envelope.

name: task_create
description: Creates a task in the local task list.

activeForm.description: Optional present-continuous verb phrase for in-progress display.

metadata.description: Optional metadata to attach to the task.

subject.description: A brief title for the task.

name: task_get
description: Gets the current status for a task by id.

name: task_list
description: Returns background tasks with status and metadata.

include_terminal.description: Include completed/failed/canceled tasks. Defaults to true.

limit.description: Optional max number of tasks to return.

status.description: Optional status filter (running, completed, failed, canceled).

name: task_output
description: Returns task status/result; can wait for completion.

block.description: Wait until task reaches terminal state.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds when block=true.

name: task_stop
description: Stops a task and records a cancellation reason.

name: task_update
description: Updates task status/result/error metadata.

status.description: Task status (pending, in_progress, completed, failed, canceled, deleted).

name: team_create
description: Creates a local team context used by send_message and orchestration tools.

name: team_delete
description: Cancels a local team lifecycle and deactivates it if active.

archive.description: Archive instead of cancel/deleting lifecycle metadata.

team_name.description: Optional explicit team name. Defaults to active team.

name: team_list
description: Lists teams and lifecycle status for the current process.

limit.description: Optional max number of teams to return.

status.description: Optional team status filter (active, archived, canceled).

name: team_status
description: Gets a team record including members and message history.

team_name.description: Optional explicit team name. Defaults to active team.

name: team_update
description: Updates team metadata such as description and members.

members.description: Optional full replacement teammate member list.

team_name.description: Optional explicit team name. Defaults to active team.

name: tool_search
description: Searches registered tool names and descriptions.

max_results.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

name: worktree_enter
description: Creates a local isolated worktree directory and marks it as active.

name.description: Optional worktree name (letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash).

name: worktree_exit
description: Exits an active local worktree session, optionally removing worktree files.

discard_changes.description: Required true when action=remove to acknowledge deletion.
